note: Machine-readable governed environment catalog (INFRA-03 assignment section 7). Every runtime environment the EPD2 stack may be deployed into is declared here; deploying into an undeclared environment fails closed. No production environment exists or is declared: declaring one is a separately governed act (INFRA-07 / Production Infrastructure Baseline).

local_dev.purpose: Developer-local iterative runtime for implementing and debugging infrastructure behavior.
local_dev.db_class: ephemeral local PostgreSQL cluster, synthetic data only
local_dev.secret_source: per-run generated ephemeral secrets; never persisted to the repository
local_dev.trust_source: per-run generated ephemeral CAs and certificates
local_dev.reset_policy: destroy at will; no approval required
local_dev.evidence_requirements: none mandatory; evidence produced is non-authoritative

ci_runtime.purpose: Deterministic runtime for canonical gates and mutation suites inside CI.
ci_runtime.allowed_artifact_source: exact accepted or freshly frozen candidate bytes, digest-verified
ci_runtime.network_scope: loopback only inside the runner; no inbound exposure; egress limited to declared package/advisory endpoints of the canonical harness
ci_runtime.db_class: ephemeral PostgreSQL cluster created per run from initdb, synthetic fixtures only
ci_runtime.trust_source: per-run generated ephemeral CAs and certificates
ci_runtime.persistence: none across runs; evidence uploaded as CI artifacts
ci_runtime.evidence_requirements: complete gate evidence under validation/infra03/ plus execution logs

preview.purpose: Deterministic, isolated, observable, recoverable preview deployment of the EPD2 stack for SYSTEM TRIAL PREVIEW preparation.
preview.allowed_artifact_source: exact accepted candidate artifacts only, digest-verified against acceptance records (supply-chain handoff, INFRA-02)
preview.network_scope: segmented loopback runtime (public/application/data/admin_ops/voting/observability zones); no real public exposure until a governed preview host exists
preview.db_class: dedicated real PostgreSQL cluster per preview instance; TLS required; per-service roles; synthetic deterministic fixtures only
preview.secret_source: per-deployment generated secrets injected at start; classified in the secret inventory; never in repository, images, manifests or logs
preview.trust_source: per-deployment CAs: application mTLS CA, data-zone CA and a separate voting-zone CA; delivered as files with restrictive modes
preview.persistence: declared volumes only: pg data directory persists across service restarts within one preview instance; evidence persists; secrets/trust are instance-scoped
preview.exposure: single TLS ingress endpoint; admin plane is a local unix socket, never a public port
preview.reset_policy: destroy/reset only with explicit target identity matching this catalog entry and the running instance marker; production-like targets refused
preview.evidence_requirements: full lifecycle evidence: deployment, readiness, probes, drift, redeploy, rollback, failure/recovery, reset proof
preview.operator_ownership: EPD2 INFRA maintainer (project owner) until CTRL governs operator roles
prohibited_use: real voting or legally binding operations
reuse of production DBs, domains, secret namespaces, queues, storage or signing keys
public advertising of the endpoint as a live system
